knowledge:
- key_parameters: normalizationMod=A list of logical vectors specifying which arrays/spots to process ;; channelBackgroundFilter=Slot name for storing background filter logical mask (e.g., "bgf") ;; channelAndVector=Slot name to perform logical AND with (e.g., "bgf") ;; quality=Slot name representing the intensity channel to stabilize or test (e.g., "GrnF", "qua") ;; channelInclude=Slot name for filtering beads (e.g., "bgf") ;; channelOutput=Slot name for outputting processed data (e.g., "vst", "qua") ;; spotsToProcess=List of logical vectors for subsetting arrays in summarization
- alternatives: For background correction, use bacgroundCorrect (outlier-based filtering) as an alternative to backgroundChannelSubtract (subtraction) or xieBacgroundCorrect (RMA-like convolution). For transformation, use varianceBeadStabilise (VST) as an alternative to selectedChannelTransform with log2TransformPositive (log2 transformation). For testing, use doTTests (bead-level t-test) as an alternative to doProbeTTests (probe-level t-test).
- when_to_use: Use when performing bead-level (unsummarized detector-level) preprocessing and analysis of Illumina microarray data, particularly when handling unequal vector lengths across arrays.
- pitfalls: Ensure correct mapping between "Array Address Id" and "Illumina Probe Id" or "Symbol" using annotation packages or manufacturer files. Beads with negative values should be handled (e.g., using nonPositiveCorrect) before downstream analysis. normalizationMod must match the structure of the input list of beadLevelData objects.

workflows.name: bead_level_preprocessing_and_analysis
workflows.intent: Preprocess raw Illumina bead-level data (background correction, variance stabilization, quantile normalization), perform differential expression testing, and summarize the data for downstream use or export.
input: blimatesting (list of beadLevelData objects containing raw Illumina microarray data)
adrToIllumina (data frame mapping Array Address IDs to Illumina Probe IDs)
workflows.stages:
1. Define experimental groups and processing masks.
2. Perform background outlier correction and non-positive value correction.
3. Apply variance stabilizing transformation.
4. Perform quantile normalization on unequal length vectors.
5. Conduct bead-level and probe-level differential expression testing.
6. Summarize bead-level data to probe-level matrices for export.
workflows.code:
groups1 = "A";
groups2 = "E";
sampleNames = list()
groups1Mod = list()
groups2Mod = list()
processingMod = list()
for(i in 1:length(blimatesting))
{
	p = pData(blimatesting[[i]]@experimentData$phenoData)
	groups1Mod[[i]] = p$Group %in% groups1;
	groups2Mod[[i]] = p$Group %in% groups2;
	processingMod[[i]] = p$Group %in% c(groups1, groups2);
	sampleNames[[i]] = p$Name
}
blimatesting = bacgroundCorrect(blimatesting, normalizationMod = processingMod, 
		channelBackgroundFilter="bgf")
blimatesting = nonPositiveCorrect(blimatesting, normalizationMod = processingMod, 
		channelCorrect="GrnF",  channelBackgroundFilter="bgf", channelAndVector="bgf")
blimatesting = varianceBeadStabilise(blimatesting, normalizationMod = processingMod, 
		quality="GrnF", channelInclude="bgf", channelOutput="vst")
blimatesting = quantileNormalize(blimatesting, normalizationMod = processingMod, 
		channelNormalize="vst", channelOutput="qua", channelInclude="bgf")
probeTest <- doProbeTTests(blimatesting, groups1Mod, groups2Mod, 
		transformation=NULL, quality="qua", channelInclude="bgf")
beadTest <- doTTests(blimatesting, groups1Mod, groups2Mod, 
		transformation=NULL, quality="qua", channelInclude="bgf")
nonnormalized = createSummarizedMatrix(blimatesting, spotsToProcess=processingMod, quality="GrnF", channelInclude="bgf", 
        annotationTag="Name")
normalized = createSummarizedMatrix(blimatesting, spotsToProcess=processingMod, quality="qua", channelInclude="bgf", 
        annotationTag="Name")

workflows.name: alternative_preprocessing_options
workflows.intent: Apply alternative background subtraction, RMA-like convolution, or log2 transformation methods on bead-level data.
input: blimatestingall (list of beadLevelData objects containing raw Illumina microarray data)
negAdr (vector of negative control probe array addresses)
workflows.stages:
1. Perform graphical background subtraction or RMA-like background convolution.
2. Apply log2 transformation instead of variance stabilization.
workflows.code:
blimatestingall = backgroundChannelSubtract(blimatestingall, normalizationMod = NULL,
        channelSubtractFrom = "GrnF", channelSubtractWhat = "GrnB", channelResult = "BGS")
blimatestingall = xieBacgroundCorrect(blimatestingall, normalizationMod = NULL,
        negativeArrayAddresses=negAdr, channelCorrect="GrnF", channelResult="XIE",
        channelInclude="bgf")
blimatestingall = selectedChannelTransform(blimatestingall, normalizationMod=NULL,
        channelTransformFrom="GrnF", channelResult="LOG",
        transformation=log2TransformPositive)
